note: Itasca County Land Department campground at the fairgrounds in Grand Rapids, among tall red and white pines, renovated in 2023. The fairgrounds' Trailhead Building is the information center for the Mesabi bike trail; fair, races and festivals are held on the grounds in summer. --Claude
summary: County page + Campspot: 57 sites (Campspot lists 38 full hookup, 2 W/E, 15 rustic RV/tent), back-in pads 35-60 ft, 20/30/50 amp, showers/laundry/dump, online-only via Campspot, check-in 3/out 11. Fees ($20 rustic / $40 W-E / $50 FHU + $7 booking fee) and the 2026 season (closes Oct 30) match what is stored. Not waterfront kept.

Season: stored closes 10-29 vs county 'The Trailhead Campground will close on October 30, 2026' (presumably the last night is the 29th); left alone. The 2027 opening is not posted.
Base rate: the $20 rustic sites are listed on Campspot as 'Rustic RV or Tenting' with a 55-ft rig limit, so they fit a 23-ft motorhome and stay the base.

Event-heavy fairgrounds: county fair Aug 19-23, car show July 24-26, bluegrass festival June 19-21, North Star Expo Sept 18-19 (2026), plus raceway events in summer - noise/availability, not a criteria problem. 'ALL OFF-HIGHWAY VEHICLES (OHV) ARE NOT ALLOWED IN THE FAIRGROUNDS PARK.'
